[Act: companies
 Chapter: Winding Up
 Section: 303::Appeals from orders made before commencement of Act.
]


Nothing in this Chapter shall affect the operation or enforcement of any order made by any Court in any proceedings for the winding up of a company immediately before the commencement of this Act and an appeal against such order shall be filed before such authority competent to hear such appeals before such commencement. [Part II.—Voluntary winding up] Omitted by the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 (31 of 2016), s. 255 and the Eleventh Schedule (w.e.f. 15-11-2016).
